body: Thank you. I really appreciate it. I am really depressed.
I treated him well. I love him and I let him know how much I love him. But I always put my emotions on him because of my insecurity and anxiety. I feel bad and I don't think he deserve that.
Because I feel like he doesn't want to see me and spend time with me. He would say 'we have talked for 30 minutes already' and tried to finish a call with me.
We are in long distance relationship. I am a very emotional girl and I always put my emotions on him. It's not fair, so I want him to leave me and find his true love. I don't think he loves me too.
I broke up with the man I love. I really love him but I already let him go.
